caveat: n=12 prove keys on one TypeScript monorepo (ClawQL) is a small test on CodeGraph home turf. Predeclared margin + no-harm + no-tools are required so a home-turf win cannot sneak past a weak bar.

no_harm.purpose: CodeGraph must not make easy questions worse

arms.purpose: ClawQL is public; measure how much the frontier model answers from memory alone
Treatment — codegraph_* (+ read as needed). Grep is NOT available on this arm.

definitions.W: #prove keys CodeGraph correct and grep wrong
definitions.L: #prove keys grep correct and CodeGraph wrong

no_harm_pass.rule: On the 6 grep-solvable no-harm keys, A-codegraph answer-correct count >= 5 (allow one flake). Failure => treat as tie => purge.
also_report: A-no-tools prove + no-harm rates (memory baseline; does not rescue CodeGraph)

no_tools_reporting.note: If A-no-tools already clears many prove keys, the Net vs grep overstates tool value — publish the rates; do not keep on memory alone.

human_pass_gate.prove_keys: review all 12; confirm single grep cannot answer each
human_pass_gate.doc_keys: stratified random sample ~60; stop if >=3 defects and fix builder
